title: SDR Viagens Internacional - Sênior
description:
SDR Viagens Internacional - Sênior — LUA DE MEL & EXPERIÊNCIAS PERSONALIZADAS (BRASIL)


A Honeymooners é uma agência internacional especializada em luas de mel e viagens de alto valor , com forte presença no mercado dos Estados Unidos.


Esta não é uma vaga de call center nem de agendamento mecânico.

Buscamos um(a) SDR SÊNIOR , com experiência real em vendas consultivas, capaz de criar conexão humana imediata e abrir o caminho certo para uma venda premium.


Estamos fortalecendo o topo do funil internacional e procuramos alguém que entenda que velocidade, qualidade do primeiro contato e leitura de intenção fazem toda a diferença .


O que você vai fazer:

• Ser o primeiro contato humano com casais internacionais que solicitam informações sobre a lua de mel;

• Entrar em contato rapidamente após o pedido (tempo de resposta é crítico);

• Criar uma conexão inicial de confiança e entusiasmo;

• Qualificar momento, intenção e expectativas do casal;

• Agendar reuniões qualificadas com os(as) consultores(as) de viagens;

• Garantir follow-ups consistentes e bem estruturados;

• Registrar contexto, histórico e interações no CRM.

Você não fará orçamentos nem fechará vendas.

Seu foco é conexão, clareza e agendamento de alta qualidade .


Procuramos alguém que:

• Tenha experiência comprovada como SDR ou em vendas consultivas;

• Domine CRM no dia a dia (experiência com HubSpot é um diferencial );

• Comunique-se em inglês avançado (oral e escrito);

• Tenha ritmo, disciplina e foco em métricas;

• Seja confortável em conversas por telefone e videochamada;

• Prefira ganhar por performance e impacto, não por conforto;

• Tenha maturidade para atuar em um ambiente internacional exigente.

Experiência no setor de turismo é um diferencial muito importante , especialmente com produtos de alto valor.


Esta vaga NÃO é para você se:

• Procura apenas responder mensagens ou e-mails;

• Não gosta de falar ao telefone;

• Precisa de tarefas previsíveis e ritmo lento;

• Fica desconfortável com metas claras e avaliação semanal;

• Procura algo temporário ou “tranquilo”.


Modelo de trabalho:

• Full-time;

• 100% remoto;

• Horário alinhado com o fuso dos EUA;

• Modelo de contratação: PJ.


Remuneração:

• Remuneração fixa competitiva para o mercado brasileiro;

• Variável atrelado à performance e à qualidade dos agendamentos;

• Upside real conforme consistência e resultados.


Onboarding & crescimento:

• Treinamento inicial estruturado (imersão nos produtos, posicionamento da marca, roteiros de ligação e uso do CRM).

• Acompanhamento próximo nos primeiros meses.

• Possibilidade real de crescimento , como:

  • migração para consultor(a) de viagens internacional;
  • evolução para liderança do time de pré-vendas.


Processo seletivo:

  • Análise de currículo;
  • Entrevista inicial (fit, comunicação e ambição);
  • Entrevista com gestor;
  • Simulação prática / roleplay;
  • Decisão rápida.


Sobre a Honeymooners

Somos uma agência de viagens internacional especializada em luas de mel e viagens personalizadas, fundada pelo casal português Joana & André .

Trabalhamos com casais exigentes e experiências de alto valor — e acreditamos que o primeiro contato precisa estar no mesmo nível do que prometemos na viagem .

Aqui não prometemos facilidade.

Prometemos crescimento para quem aguenta ritmo, responsabilidade e impacto real.


Como se candidatar

Envie seu currículo para:


Assunto: SDR Internacional Sênior – BRASIL – (SEU NOME)

title: Python/Cloud Platform Developer
description:
Python/Cloud Platform Developer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


We seek an experienced high-performing Python engineer for a position supporting and developing new tools and processes to be used on an on-prem private cloud application. Your role will involve to communicate technical concepts clearly, facilitate discussions, collaborate with stakeholders, provide project updates and mentor team members.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Develop high performance cloud and container technologies mostly leveraging Python as the main programming language;
  • Develop and deliver high quality solutions and code;
  • Develop unit tests, improving the SDLC;
  • Investigate and resolve issues reported during testing and customer integration;
  • Actively participate in all aspects of an agile software development process;
  • Work as part of a team focused on containerization, virtualization and fault tolerant/carrier grade development;
  • Contribute to a highly available orchestration platform used to deploy private cloud platform aimed to be at the core of 5G and distributed Edge deployments worldwide.

Essential Skills


  • Solid backend developer (preferably but not restricted to Python), knowledgeable in Linux Essentials:
  • Medium knowledge in concepts of hardware, processes, programs and the components of the Linux Operating System;
  • How to work on the command line and with files;
  • How to create and restore compressed backups and archives;
  • System security: users/groups and file permissions for public and private directories;
  • How to create and run simple scripts;
  • Interested in working on development and troubleshooting of a highly distributed orchestration platform supporting multiple vendors;
  • Strong computer networking knowledge and transport (TCP/UDP/etc.) layers;
  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts;
  • Experience collaborating effectively across remote teams and time zones, and collaborating with Senior Technical Leaders;
  • Experience with GIT, Jira, Gitlab and code review tools;
  • Experience with container technologies (e.g., Docker, Linux Containers, etc.);
  • Experience with Kubernetes Cluster Administration (design infrastructure that involves one or more Kubernetes clusters, configure, control, and monitor Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with Docker;
  • Experience with Helm.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience with Kubernetes App Development (design and development of applications that run in Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with PostgreSQL as a developer;
  • Experience with RabbitMQ as a developer.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Analista de BI Senior - Remoto
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Detalhes da oportunidade

Modelo de atuação: Remoto

Modelo de contratação: CLT + Benefícios


Principais Responsabilidades

- Traduzir necessidades de negócio em indicadores, análises e visualizações claras

- Construir, manter e evoluir dashboards executivos e operacionais

- Realizar análises exploratórias e diagnósticas, identificando padrões, tendências e oportunidades

- Apoiar decisões estratégicas por meio de insights orientados por dados

- Atuar na modelagem de dados (conceitual, lógica e física)

- Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados, garantindo qualidade, performance e escalabilidade

- Trabalhar com dados estruturados e semiestruturados

- Garantir consistência entre fontes, métricas e camadas analíticas

- Documentar métricas, indicadores e fontes (data dictionary / métricas oficiais)

- Apoiar iniciativas de governança de dados e boas práticas analíticas

- Atuar na resolução de inconsistências e problemas de dados

- Apresentar análises de forma clara, didática e orientada à ação


Requisitos Técnicos Obrigatórios

- Experiência sólida como Analista de BI / Dados

- Domínio de SQL (consultas complexas, CTEs, otimização)

- Experiência com modelagem de dados (star schema, snowflake, etc.)

- Vivência com ferramentas de BI

- Experiência com Python ou R para análise de dados (pandas, numpy, etc.)

- Conhecimento em ETL / ELT e pipelines de dados

- Experiência com bases de dados relacionais e analíticas

- Familiaridade com ambientes de dados em cloud (AWS)


E temos o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: M&A Advisor
description:
Expanda sua Prática de M&A: Una-se à Rede Internacional da ONEtoONE Corporate Finance


Conecte sua expertise ao mercado global. Transforme sua assessoria local em uma potência internacional.


A ONEtoONE Corporate Finance Group convida assessores de M&A e boutiques independentes de renome no Brasil a integrarem nossa rede global. Combinamos tecnologia de ponta, colaboração internacional e um back office completo para potencializar sua originação e execução de deals no middle-market.


Quem Somos


Somos uma rede internacional de investment banking especializada em assessoria de M&A para o middle-market. Conectamos mais de 150 assessores em mais de 80 cidades ao redor do mundo, com foco em transações cross-border.


Nota Importante: Esta é uma oportunidade de Membership (Afiliação) para profissionais e firmas independentes; não se trata de uma vaga de emprego (CLT) ou prestação de serviços terceirizados.


Ferramentas e Suporte de Classe Mundial


Ao longo de duas décadas, a ONEtoONE investiu no desenvolvimento de ferramentas exclusivas que permitem aos nossos membros:


  • Originação de Elite: Conquiste mais e melhores mandatos.
  • Inteligência de Mercado: Identifique compradores ou targets ideais globalmente.
  • Back Office Dedicado: Suporte em todas as fases — desde o pitch e análise financeira até a documentação e busca de contrapartes.
  • Dados Premium: Acesso a perfis de mais de 450 milhões de empresas e dados de transações globais.


Colaboração Sem Fronteiras


No Brasil, o relacionamento é a base de tudo. Nossa rede permite que você colabore com especialistas em diversos setores e países sem restrições geográficas ou setoriais. Você terá a liberdade de operar globalmente, utilizando ferramentas de IA e bancos de dados proprietários para multiplicar seu alcance e sua receita.


Perfil Ideal


Buscamos profissionais brasileiros com o seguinte perfil:


  • Experiência: Mínimo de 10 anos em Corporate Finance, Private Equity, M&A ou assessoria transacional.
  • Idiomas: Inglês avançado/fluente (essencial para colaboração internacional).
  • Mindset: Perfil empreendedor, proativo e orientado a resultados.
  • Expertise: Forte rede de relacionamentos local e capacidade analítica.
  • Visão: Desejo de portar uma marca global de investment banking e trabalhar de forma colaborativa.


O Que Você Ganha


  • Suporte Full Back Office: Originadores, analistas e especialistas em marketing, jurídico e TI à sua disposição.
  • Tecnologia de Ponta: Acesso às melhores bases de dados de M&A do mundo e ferramentas de IA exclusivas.
  • Networking Global: Conexão direta com pares em 80+ cidades e especialistas setoriais.
  • Transparência: Estrutura de fee-sharing clara que valoriza o trabalho em equipe.
  • Liberdade: Autonomia total para gerir seu negócio com o suporte de uma marca global.


Pronto para elevar o nível da sua assessoria?


Se você tem a experiência e a motivação para expandir sua prática de M&A para além das fronteiras brasileiras, convidamos você a se candidatar para a rede ONEtoONE International .

title: Sourcer Pleno
description:
Estamos em busca de Sourcer Sênior para integrar o time de Talent Acquisition com foco em contratação LATAM e Brasil da AI/R Company , grupo que reúne empresas como Avenue Code, Invillia e Compass UOL. Você será responsável por mapear o mercado, gerar listas qualificadas e atuar em parceria com os recrutadores, garantindo uma experiência de candidato fluida e processos mais assertivos.


Você será responsável por:

  • Atuar na identificação, mapeamento e prospecção ativa de talentos para posições técnicas (Desenvolvimento, QA, DevOps, Data, etc.);
  • Utilizar estratégias avançadas de sourcing ;
  • Criar e manter pipelines de talentos atualizados e segmentados por senioridade, tecnologia e região;
  • Conduzir primeiros contatos com candidatos , apresentando a oportunidade e avaliando o fit inicial;
  • Alimentar e manter atualizadas as informações no ATS e LinkedIn Recruiter ;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o(a) Tech Recruiter e a liderança para alinhar perfis e prioridades de busca ;
  • Contribuir com relatórios de funil de recrutamento e métricas de conversão;
  • Apoiar ações de employer branding e engajamento de talentos .


O que você precisa ter:

  • Experiência prévia como Sourcer, Talent Researcher ou Recrutador com foco em tecnologia;
  • Desejável vivência com vagas de diferentes países;
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de busca e automação (LinkedIn Recruiter, AmazingHiring, SeekOut, HireEZ, etc.);
  • Experiência com buscas booleanas ;
  • Capacidade analítica e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Desejável Inglês avançado;
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal, com foco em relacionamento e abordagem personalizada.


A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. Por se tratar de uma empresa de consultoria, a Avenue Code poderá compartilhar suas informações com seus clientes e com outras empresas do Grupo CompassUol, às quais os(as) consultores(as) da Avenue Code estejam alocados para a prestação de serviços.

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Realizar diagnósticos energéticos nas unidades operacionais, identificando oportunidades de otimização do consumo e melhoria de performance.

  • Monitorar e analisar indicadores de consumo e desempenho energético, assegurando acompanhamento sistemático dos resultados.

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia Elétrica, Mecânica, de Produção, Controle e Automação ou áreas correlatas.

  • Noções de diagnóstico energético e hidroenergético (levantamento de dados, medições, baseline e verificação de resultados).
  • Domínio de Excel para organização e análise de dados e PowerPoint para apresentações; Power BI como diferencial.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens às unidades de negócio, conforme a necessidade dos projetos/operações.

title: Blockchain Developer
description:
Job Description

We are seeking a Blockchain Developer to build and maintain decentralized applications (dApps), smart contracts, and blockchain integrations that support our Web3 community hub in art and technology. You will develop secure, scalable solutions for tokenized art, NFT platforms, DeFi features, and community governance tools — enabling creators, collaborators, and users to interact seamlessly in a global Web3 ecosystem. This role involves hands-on coding, testing, and deployment on chains like Ethereum or Solana, with a focus on innovative features that foster collaboration and creativity.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and implement smart contracts: write, audit, and deploy Solidity/Rust code for features like NFT minting, token distribution, DAOs, and royalty mechanisms tailored to art/tech communities.
  • Build dApps and integrations: develop frontend/backend for Web3 apps using frameworks like React, Web3.js/Ethers.js; integrate with wallets (MetaMask, WalletConnect) and APIs for seamless user experiences.
  • Optimize for scalability and security: implement gas-efficient code, conduct security audits (e.g., using Slither), and ensure compliance with best practices to prevent vulnerabilities.
  • Collaborate on projects: work with designers, marketers, and community leads to create tools for collaboration (e.g., tokenized events, shared ownership models) in art and technology.
  • Testing and maintenance: write unit/integration tests (Hardhat, Foundry); monitor on-chain performance, debug issues, and upgrade contracts as needed.
  • Research and innovation: explore emerging tech (Layer 2s, zero-knowledge proofs) to enhance platform features; contribute to open-source or community-driven developments.
  • Documentation and support: create technical docs, APIs, and guides for community developers; provide support for integrations and troubleshooting.
Requirements
  • 3–5+ years of experience in blockchain development, with hands-on work on live dApps or smart contracts (e.g., Ethereum/Solana projects); proven portfolio of deployed code.
  • Proficiency in languages and tools: Solidity/Rust for contracts, JavaScript/TypeScript for dApps, frameworks like Truffle/Hardhat/Anchor, and testing libraries.
  • Deep knowledge of Web3 ecosystems: DeFi, NFTs, DAOs, token standards (ERC-20/721/1155), and blockchain concepts (consensus, scalability, security).
  • Experience with art/tech applications: familiarity with NFT platforms, tokenized assets, or creative Web3 tools preferred.
  • Strong problem-solving: ability to debug complex issues, optimize performance, and ensure secure code in decentralized environments.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (preferred); crypto-native passion with contributions to Web3 projects required.
  • Excellent collaboration skills; ability to work in a fully remote, fast-paced team with global communities.
What We Offer
  • Competitive compensation: $140,000–$200,000 base salary depending on experience + performance-based bonuses tied to project deliveries and platform growth.
  • Token/equity incentives in community projects and Web3 initiatives.
  • Comprehensive benefits: health insurance, retirement contributions, generous paid time off.
  • Professional development: access to conferences (Devcon, Token2049), tools, and ongoing learning in blockchain/Web3.
  • Opportunity to develop innovative blockchain solutions that connect art, technology, and global Web3 communities.


If you're a blockchain developer excited to build tools for creative Web3 collaboration, send your resume to We are an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity.

title: Analista de Dados Pleno | Engenharia e Modelagem de Dados
description:
A Fasters está procurando gente talentosa para formar um time que irá atuar na área de desenvolvimento. Irá fazer parte de um ambiente voltado para inovação e irá participar ativamente no crescimento do projeto.


Buscamos um profissional com boa comunicação, que tenha facilidade de se relacionar com pessoas e que esteja constantemente se atualizando em busca de novos conhecimentos da área.


Essa vaga se destina para todo o Brasil :)


Responsabilidades:

• Desenvolver e gerenciar pipelines de ETL em larga escala, otimizados para eficiência e confiabilidade.

• Implementar processos de qualidade e validação de dados.

• Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes de BI e Data Science para suportar projetos analíticos.

• Garantir o desempenho, a escalabilidade e a segurança dos sistemas de dados.


Soft Skills:

• Capacidade analítica e pensamento crítico para resolver problemas complexos.

• Comunicação efetiva e colaboração com equipes multidisciplinares.

• Proatividade e atenção meticulosa aos detalhes.

• Adaptabilidade e resiliência.

• Gestão de tempo e priorização.


Hard Skills:

• Experiência com modernização de BI (conhecimento sobre migração de ETL e Data Warehousing).

• Modelagem de dados para analytics (criação de Data Lakes, Data Warehouses e Data Marts).

• Experiência com banco de dados relacionais e dimensionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, Vertica).

• Apache Airflow.

• Conhecimento em streaming de dados (Kafka, Kinesis).

• Sólidos conhecimentos em SQL e otimização de consultas.

• Domínio do Python e suas bibliotecas.

• Conhecimento em Spark e PySpark.

• Governança de Dados (aplicação de boas práticas de segurança, como LGPD, GDPR, Privacy by Design).


Diferenciais

• Experiência com machine learning e modelos preditivos para análise de dados.

• Conhecimentos em Delta Lake.

• Experiência com API para dados em tempo real.

• Conhecimentos de cloud (AWS, Azure)


Regime de contratação PJ, 40h semanais.

  • Acesso a plataformas de cursos.

title: Analista / Especialista em GIS & Documentação Técnica
description:
Buscamos um(a) profissional com sólida base em Sistemas de Informação Geográfica (GIS), com perfil comunicativo e organizado, capaz de atuar na documentação técnica, apoio a usuários e disseminação de boas práticas em soluções GIS, especialmente em redes de utilities.



Principais competências e conhecimentos esperados:


  • Conhecimento em GIS, com entendimento de dados espaciais, mapas, camadas, simbologia e fluxos de trabalho.
  • Experiência ou familiaridade com redes de utilities (água, esgoto, energia, telecom ou gás), incluindo conceitos de ativos, conectividade e operação.
  • Boa escrita técnica, com capacidade de elaborar documentação clara, objetiva e orientada ao usuário.
  • Experiência com Git (controle de versões), incluindo versionamento de documentação, organização de repositórios e colaboração em equipe.
  • Elaboração de documentação técnica e funcional, como manuais, guias rápidos, FAQs, wikis e notas de versão.


Produção de materiais instrucionais, incluindo:


  • Tutoriais passo a passo
  • Vídeos explicativos
  • Figuras, diagramas e fluxos de uso para apoio ao usuário
  • Boa comunicação, tanto escrita quanto verbal, com capacidade de dialogar com perfis técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Organização, atenção a detalhes e compromisso com padronização e qualidade da informação.


Diferenciais desejáveis:


  • Experiência com plataformas GIS corporativas ou WebGIS.
  • Vivência em ambientes colaborativos e multidisciplinares.
  • Conhecimento de boas práticas de documentação técnica e UX writing.
  • Experiência prévia com projetos de utilities ou infraestrutura.

title: Domain Expert – Q&A Development(Chemistry)
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.


Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.


We are seeking highly skilled Chemistry and Mathematics professionals to develop high-quality Chain of Thought (CoT) Question & Answers for advanced scientific and mathematical problem-solving.

The ideal candidate will have strong conceptual foundations, rigorous analytical skills, and experience in structured scientific reasoning. Proficiency in LaTeX is essential for producing clear, well-formatted, step-by-step solutions.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop detailed Chain of Thought (CoT) Q&As across advanced scientific and mathematical domains.
  • Ensure logical coherence and structured reasoning in both questions and solutions.
  • Use LaTeX for precise scientific notation and documentation.
  • Collaborate with internal review teams to ensure consistency and quality.
  • Conduct in-depth reviews to maintain scientific accuracy and adherence to guidelines.
  • Contribute subject-matter expertise across the following domains:


Chemistry

  • Polymer Chemistry
  • Analytical Chemistry
  • Physical Chemistry
  • Inorganic Chemistry
  • Organic Chemistry



Qualifications & Skills (Consolidated)

  • Master’s degree or PhD in relevant Chemistry domains.
  • Strong academic or research expertise with the ability to create structured scientific explanations and step-by-step analytical solutions .
  • Mandatory experience in academic content development, research, or structured Q&A creation .
  • Strong proficiency in LaTeX for technical and scientific writing.
  • Excellent analytical thinking, scientific problem-solving ability , and attention to detail.
  • Ability to simplify complex concepts into clear, logically structured reasoning .
  • Strong written communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a collaborative, review-driven environment .
  • Preferred: Experience with AI/ML-based problem formulation, evaluation, or model testing , and familiarity with educational technology platforms and digital assessment workflows .
  • Additional advantage: Experience in red teaming or adversarial evaluation .
  • 6 months to 2 years of relevant experience preferred.

title: SAP Signavio Consultant
description:
SAP Signavio Consultant – Remote

Location : LATAM

Type : Contract


Job Description

We are seeking a SAP Signavio Consultant to join our team supporting process discovery, modeling, and process intelligence using SAP Signavio tools. This position is remote from Latin America and requires working in collaboration with US‑based functional and business teams (US time zones).


Responsibilities

  • Lead process discovery and modeling using SAP Signavio across core ERP domains (O2C, P2P, R2R, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain).
  • Support life sciences‑specific process mapping.
  • Deploy and manage SAP Signavio solutions (Process Manager, Collaboration Hub, Process Intelligence).
  • Analyze process mining data and identify improvement opportunities.
  • Collaborate effectively with US teams and business stakeholders.


Required Skills

  • 4–8 years’ experience in business process management, including 2–3 years with SAP Signavio.
  • Strong understanding of life sciences operational and compliance processes.
  • Familiarity with SAP S/4HANA or ECC ERP processes.
  • Excellent English communication skills and experience working with US teams.
  • Ability to work independently in a distributed nearshore setup.


Preferred Qualifications

  • SAP Signavio certifications.
  • Experience in pharma, biotech, or medical devices.
  • Knowledge of SAP Activate or other business transformation methodologies.


Background Checks

Full background check, employment history, education verification for the last 7 years, and a mandatory 10‑panel drug test for selected candidates.


Interested? Apply here or reach out directly to start a conversation at

title: Project Manager with logistics experience - Remote
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • At least ten years of professional experience in successfully executing and managing complex IT projects (including Logistic integration Projects);
  • Experience with 3PL Integrations;
  • Strong experience in project management methodologies (classic and agile);
  • Organized, result-oriented work style characterized by a high degree of initiative;
  • PMP certification;
  • Written and oral fluency in English (+B2) - mandatory.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: remote.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV!

title: Mobile Developer (iOS)
description:
About

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


Job Summary

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.


Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior iOS Engineer to design, build, and ship high-quality mobile applications, with a strong focus on iOS-first development . This role is ideal for someone who has spent years building production iOS apps, thrives in early-stage or fast-moving environments , and enjoys owning features end to end—from architecture decisions to App Store delivery.


You will work closely with product, design, and backend teams to deliver scalable, high-performance mobile experiences while maintaining clean, testable, and well-structured code.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain advanced iOS applications , with Android considered a plus.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define requirements, design solutions, and ship new features.
  • Own performance, quality, and responsiveness across the mobile app.
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, crashes, and complex bugs.
  • Write clean, testable, and maintainable code, contributing to automation and CI/CD workflows.
  • Integrate mobile applications with RESTful or GraphQL APIs and third-party libraries.
  • Make informed architectural decisions suitable for scalable MVPs and growing products .
  • Stay current with iOS best practices, platform updates, and modern mobile development trends.
  • Actively participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies , including planning, reviews, and technical discussions.


Minimum Qualifications

  • 8–10 years of professional experience in mobile development, with a strong focus on iOS.
  • Proven track record of shipping at least one high-quality iOS app to the App Store .
  • Deep proficiency in Swift and SwiftUI (or UIKit, depending on project needs).
  • Solid understanding of the full mobile application development lifecycle , from concept to release and iteration.
  • Strong knowledge of mobile UI/UX patterns and Apple platform guidelines.
  • Hands-on experience integrating mobile apps with RESTful or GraphQL APIs .
  • Proficiency with Git , Xcode , and modern dependency managers such as Swift Package Manager .
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ownership mindset.
  • Advanced written and spoken English for collaboration in a distributed, international team.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with UIKit , Combine , Async/Await , CoreData , or Realm .
  • Experience implementing or customizing video playback features using AVPlayer / AVKit (or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with Android development (Kotlin/Java) is a plus.
  • Experience setting up or working with CI/CD pipelines for mobile applications.
  • Experience using mobile performance and profiling tools (Instruments, Crashlytics, etc.).
  • Background working in early-stage startups or building MVPs from scratch.


Benefits

  • Yearly Office Allowance Budget
  • Macbook Purchase Support
  • Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.


Flatiron Software Co has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, colour, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.

title: Java Backend Developer Tech Lead
description:
Java Backend Developer Tech Lead


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary


As a Java Tech Lead, you will make a significant contribution to the software development, maintenance and performance improvement. You'll be is involved in every stage of the digital product development lifecycle, from planning and architecture to release, distribution, and quality assurance.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Acts as the primary technical point of contact for the team towards the client;
  • Work in a dynamic team to provide solutions with Java and NodeJS applications;
  • Lead technical discussions with the team;
  • Ensure the team is operating efficiently in the technical activities;
  • Participate in the complete cycle of development from design, development, testing and deployment;
  • Raise and discuss trade-offs of different design approaches;
  • Ensures the team adheres to timelines, quality standards and best practices;
  • Ensure the project quality;
  • Help to unblock the other team members;
  • Provide technical mentorship to the team;
  • Work with the project manager to plan sprints and deliverables.

Essential Skills


  • Hands-on object oriented programming experience in Java;
  • Hands-on object oriented experience in Javascript/NodeJS;
  • Experience with AngularJS;
  • Experience in database development, both SQL and NoSQL: development, maintenance, analysis;
  • Experience developing Restful APIs;
  • Experience working in agile teams;
  • Experience with code versioning with Git;
  • Experience in AWS cloud services.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Development of secure web applications;
  • Experience with modeling, producing and consuming web services based APIs (RESTful or SOAP based);
  • Experience with Jenkins;
  • Experience with Jira and Confluence;
  • Experience with Gitlab Automation;
  • Experience with Apache Camel.


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: HR Operations Manager
description:
The HR operations manager owns the execution and continuous improvement of HR operations across the full team member lifecycle — from onboarding through offboarding. This is a hands-on role that blends operational leadership, systems ownership, and process discipline.

You will work closely with the Director of Global HR , HR Specialists, and cross-functional partners to ensure HR systems, workflows, and documentation operate smoothly and consistently across countries.

This role is centered on building, operating, and continuously elevating a high-performing HR engine, with a strong commitment to operational excellence and ongoing improvement every day.


Must haves

  • 7+ years of progressive HR experience , with a strong focus on HR operations
  • Advanced English proficiency (written and verbal)
  • Location: Ukraine, Poland, Romania
  • Experience working in technology, IT, consulting, or service-based environments
  • Proven success building, running, and improving HR processes that scale with company growth
  • Hands-on experience managing HR operations for a multi-country workforce
  • Strong experience with HRIS platforms (HiBob preferred) and modern productivity tools
  • Strong working knowledge of Jira, Confluence, Google Workspace , and related collaboration tools
  • Exceptional attention to detail and operational discipline
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities across regions in a fast-paced, distributed environment


Nice to have

  • Experience supporting distributed, multi-country teams
  • Familiarity with SOC2, ISO, or similar compliance environments
  • Experience using AI or automation to improve HR workflows, reporting, or efficiency
  • Prior people management or team-lead experience
  • Experience working alongside people / ER or HRBP roles
  • Exposure to B2B, outsourcing, or billable team models


Key responsibilities

HR operations & lifecycle management

HR systems & tools ownership

  • Own and administer HRIS systems (HiBob or comparable platforms) as the system of record
  • Configure workflows, task lists, permissions, and reporting in HR systems
  • Maintain accurate, complete, and up-to-date team member data
  • Partner with internal teams to integrate HR tools with Jira, Confluence, Google Workspace, and other productivity systems

Compliance & operational risk

  • Ensure compliance with local labor regulations, internal policies, and HR controls across geographies
  • Own HR-related audit readiness and evidence gathering (including SOC2-related controls where applicable)
  • Maintain HR documentation, SOPs, and policy acknowledgements
  • Adapt policies and practices to meet regional needs while maintaining consistency

Manager enablement (process-focused)

  • Provide managers with clear guidance on HR processes, timelines, and required documentation
  • Act as the primary owner of HR operational questions and requests
  • Escalate judgment-based or sensitive employee relations matters to the director of global HR

HR team support & execution

  • Support, mentor and coordinate the work of HR Specialist or other team members as it relates to HR operational tasks
  • Prioritize operational work, ensure follow-through, and reduce single points of failure
  • Identify opportunities for automation and efficiency using existing tools and AI-enabled workflows


What this role is not

  • This role does not own employee relations judgment, PIPs, or conflict mediation
  • This role does not serve as a people partner or HR business partner
  • Strategic people decisions and leadership coaching sit with the Director of Global HR

title: Senior Software Engineer – Platform
description:
Role: Senior Software Engineer, Platform Reliability Operations

Location: LATAM (Remote)

Type: Contract


Responsibilities:

  • Analyze and improve system design to reduce failure modes and promote self-healing systems
  • Establish and maintain robust systems that facilitate observability, encompassing logging, monitoring, distributed tracing, alerting, and offline test tools.
  • Work with development partners to shape the architecture, design, and implementations of new and existing systems to enhance their reliability, performance, efficiency, and scalability
  • Ability to work both independently as well as part of a geographically dispersed yet integrated team.
  • Collaborate with service engineers to establish Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs) for backend services.
  • Being able to identify the indications or cues that demonstrate the effectiveness of an application and having the knowledge to improve or repair its performance
  • Ability to assess options and suggest solutions when there is limited or unclear information. This position requires a level of comfort and assurance in dealing with uncertain situations.
  • Ability to work seamlessly within a team as well as manage individual tasks
  • Respond to emerging incidents, solve critical issues, and follow through with a plan for resolution or future mitigation
  • Act as an SME on the Engineering Operations team, partnering with backend services teams and application teams to overcome challenges across all the platforms where we stream our service

Required Skills:

  • 5+ years’ experience in software development
  • Degree in Computer Science or related or equivalent work experience
  • You have solid engineering and coding skills, data structure knowledge, and the ability to write high-performance production-quality code.
  • Experience building service-oriented APIs and cloud services
  • Experience designing, implementing, and deploying microservices
  • Extremely technical hands-on server software experience
  • Proficient in Golang, and JavaScript, and quick to learn new languages.
  • Experience in the Linux environment and a good understanding of its fundamentals and internals: filesystems and modern memory management, threads, and processes, the user/kernel-space divide, etc.
  • A good understanding of large-scale distributed systems in practice, including multi-tier architectures, application security, monitoring, and storage systems.
  • Working knowledge of the TCP/IP stack, internet routing, and load balancing.
  • Grit, drive, and a deep feeling of ownership.

Bonus Points for Experience with the following:

  • Golang
  • Typescript
  • Kubernetes
  • Terraform
  • Open telemetry
  • eBPF
  • Datadog
  • Helm Charts
  • HLS video transcoding, distribution & playback
  • Experience designing, implementing, and running services in high demand high-traffic environments
  • Experience with high-availability services

title: Pessoa Analista de DP Sênior
description:
Sobre a empresa


A Oficina é parceira estratégica na criação de reputação e relacionamento, por meio de histórias e causas que transformam o país.


Em 2025 lançamos um novo modelo de negócios que integra a agilidade de uma agência, a profundidade estratégica de uma consultoria e a força de uma atuação em rede.

Nesse contexto, nasceu a Rede de Reputação e Influência , a primeira Community as a Service (CaaS) de Reputação e Influência do Brasil. A iniciativa reúne 40 empresas parceiras com atuação regional e nacional, combinando tecnologia, inteligência e colaboração para antecipar cenários e apoiar decisões com agilidade e precisão.


Nos pautamos em valores como respeito, diversidade, inquietude, ética, excelência no atendimento e trabalho em equipe. Nosso ambiente de trabalho é colaborativo, inovador e orientado a resultados, com modelo híbrido, plano de carreira estruturado e investimento contínuo no desenvolvimento de pessoas.


Responsabilidade e atribuições


  • Executar e consolidar a folha de pagamento;
  • Conferir encargos e recolhimentos;
  • Executar admissões e rescisões complexas;
  • Controlar obrigações recorrentes;
  • Gerar relatórios operacionais e gerenciais;
  • Orientar tecnicamente a equipe;
  • Atender auditorias operacionais;
  • Manter controles e documentações atualizadas.


Requisitos e qualificações


Graduação em Administração de Empresas, Gestão de RH ou áreas correlatas.


Experiência com: Lançamentos de dados, verificação e fechamento da folha de pagamento, encerramento dos encargos mensais (FGTS, INSS, IRRF), processamento dos relatórios gerenciais da folha, contabilização, provisionamento, 13º salário, suporte em gestão de benefícios, controle de ponto, rescisão e férias, aplicação da CLT e CCT, envio de leiautes e fechamento do SPED e-Social, DCTF Web, RPA, tratamento de afastamentos pelo INSS, envio das obrigações anuais - DIRF e outras rotinas pertinentes à área de administração de pessoal.

title: Analista de Dados - Google Analytics & GCP
description:
A Tech For TI está com oportunidade para Analista de Dados - Google Analytics & GCP , atuar em projeto de cliente AutoTech, focada no mercado B2B, presente em diversos países.


Buscamos um (a) Analista de Dados que seja a principal referência técnica da empresa no uso estratégico e tático do ecossistema Google para dados. O papel exige proficiência total no Google Analytics 4 (GA4) para extrair insights profundos do comportamento do usuário e uma base sólida no Google Cloud Platform (GCP), particularmente o BigQuery, para manipular e analisar grandes volumes de dados. Este profissional será fundamental para a tomada de decisões baseada em dados em toda a organização.

Principais atividades:

- Liderar em Google Analytics (GA4):

- Gerenciar e otimizar totalmente a implementação e configuração do GA4, garantindo a mais alta qualidade e integridade dos dados de comportamento do usuário.

- Definir e manter o plano de mensuração completo (eventos, parâmetros, dimensões personalizadas) via Google Tag Manager (GTM).

- Liderar a análise de funis de conversão, performance de canais e modelos de atribuição, gerando recomendações diretas para Marketing e Produto.

- Governança de Dados via GCP/BigQuery:

- Ser o (a) ponto focal na utilização do Google BigQuery para ingestão, processamento e modelagem de dados web e transacionais em larga escala.

- Escrever e otimizar consultas SQL avançadas, realizando operações de ETL/ELT para combinar dados de GA4 (via exportação direta), CRM e outras fontes.

- Monitorar e gerenciar recursos do GCP (Cloud Storage, BigQuery) para garantir eficiência e controle de custos.

Visualização e Comunicação:

- Desenvolver dashboards complexos e automatizados no Looker Studio (Data Studio), garantindo que os insights sejam claros, acionáveis e acessíveis aos líderes e equipes operacionais.

- Apresentar resultados analíticos de forma persuasiva, traduzindo métricas técnicas em impacto financeiro e estratégico.


Requisitos imprescindíveis:

- Os candidatos devem demonstrar proficiência e experiência comprovada nos seguintes pontos:

- Google Analytics (GA4): Avançado/Especialista em configuração, migração, auditoria e uso estratégico da plataforma (Relatórios Padrão e Análises Exploratórias).

- Google Cloud Platform (GCP): Familiaridade sólida com a plataforma GCP, incluindo Cloud Storage e IAM.

- BigQuery e SQL: Avançada para escrever, otimizar e gerenciar consultas SQL complexas em ambientes de Big Data (BigQuery).

- Visualização de Dados: Proficiência em Looker Studio (Data Studio) para construção de relatórios e painéis automatizados e performáticos.

- Experiência Profissional: Mínimo de 3 a 5 anos como Analista de Dados, com foco direto em Web Analytics e Big Data.


Requisitos diferenciais:

- Conhecimentos e experiência com a linguagem de modelagem Looker ML.

- Certificações oficiais Google.

- Familiaridade com Python para análise e manipulação de dados.


Interessados podem se candidatar pelo Linkedin ou enviar CV para

title: Senior Golang Engineer
description:
Please note that the project operates in the UK time zone.


We are seeking a dedicated, motivated, and reliable Senior Golang Engineer who is interested in providing innovative software solutions for our clients. Be a part of our team as we continue to deliver high quality products and services. The Senior Go Engineer will be responsible for building backend services in Go in EKS, as well as some Lambdas. The overall project will be centered around providing product data and managing the product life cycle. If you are an open communicator with a passion for learning, love to think outside the box and you are excited about software development, we are looking for you!


RESPONSIBILITIES

• Use your deep expertise in Go and related technologies to develop high-quality, scalable, maintainable software solutions.

• Make technically sound decisions and champion high standards of coding and architecture best practices.

• Develop and maintain software documentation such as technical specifications and design documents.

• Continually enhance the team’s performance by mentoring, code reviews, and improving current processes in the SDLC.

• Troubleshoot and debug software issues as they arise.

• Collaborate within a cross functional team and be able to transform both functional and non-functional requirements into actionable work.

• Manage communication of progress/status to stakeholders.


WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• At least 4 years of professional software development experience.

• Proficiency in Go (Golang), including syntax, semantics, database connectivity, and object-oriented concepts.

• Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms.

• Experience working with Go frameworks such as Gin, Revel, Echo, Beego, etc.

• Strong understanding of web services (HTTP, SOAP, REST, GQL, etc.).

• Terraform, Lambdas, Writing API’s.

• Strong working knowledge of relational databases.

• Experience in troubleshooting issues and root cause analysis.

• A proven track record of delivering high quality and tested software on-time and often.

• An open mind, and the patience to explain issues in a constructive manner.

• Strong communication skills, with at least an intermediate level of English.

• Experience working in distributed, cross functional teams.


NICE TO HAVE

• Kubernetes or EKS.

• Algolia.

• Shopify.

• DynamoDB


Who We Are?

We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry’s leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals.


What's In It For You

  • We offer 100% remote work
  • Wellness/Fitness package
  • Paid trainings and certifications
  • 22 days of paid leave (27 days in the second year with us)
  • Professional Conferences and Training
  • Global Team Building Activities
  • Access to co-working spaces worldwide


Your applications and referrals are welcome!

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

title: Senior C/C++ engineer with Python
description:
Project Description:

Founded in 1984, our client is one of the world's leading provider of lithography systems for the semiconductor industry, manufacturing complex machines that are critical to the production of integrated circuits or chips. The client has its R&D and manufacturing operations in The Netherlands.

Luxoft is currently searching to augment the Development & Engineering Department with a talented software engineer to design and implement embedded software for systems among the highest precision ever produced in the world.


Responsibilities:

  • As a software engineer, you will be working on Linux server applications for metrology components and on complex algorithms application software. You will be working with electrical engineers, mechatronic engineers and system engineers to define the software requirements.
  • A team of about 10 people consisting of a team lead, a sw architect, a few senior developers. After your SW design is approved you are responsible for implementing the design in Python & C for new modules.
  • During testing, you will collect the necessary data so you can write a test report.
  • The development environment is Red Hat Linux, execution environment is Wind River Linux. The software release driving a client machine is 40 million lines of code. Client SW teams work in various modes such as Agile and SAFE.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • We are looking for colleagues with at least 5 years of development experience.
  • Python: application coding
  • Linux (one of more of the following): familiar with command line tools, makefile, git, shell and python scripting
  • Embedded C and C++: understanding and maintaining legacy code. Adding new features while keeping compliance with established architecture.
  • Version control using command line is also required - Git, Clear Case and SVN, in this order of priority.


Languages:

  • English: C1 Advanced

title: Regulatory Affairs Specialist
description:
Location : Brazil (Remote opportunity)


Join our team and start a new adventure in an international, dynamic, and highly regulated environment, where you can grow your career within a rapidly expanding organization.

Being a consultant at Amaris Consulting means positioning yourself as a technical and functional reference in Regulatory Affairs , acting as a strategic partner to our clients thanks to:

  • Your leadership and communication skills , enabling you to build trusted relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Your critical and regulatory mindset , allowing you to anticipate risks and propose solutions aligned with current regulations.
  • Your curiosity and continuous learning , supporting clients across multiple industries in complex regulatory contexts.

Your missions

  • Lead Regulatory Affairs activities for medical devices , ensuring compliance with European regulations (EU MDR – Regulation (EU) 2017/745).
  • Act as an expert in medical device classification , with a focus on Class IIa and IIb , ensuring correct application of classification rules.
  • Coordinate the preparation, review, and maintenance of technical documentation (EU MDR Annexes II and III).
  • Provide expert support in CE Marking processes and conformity assessments , including direct interaction with Notified Bodies .
  • Analyze and manage regulatory changes , assessing their impact on the product portfolio and defining regulatory strategies.
  • Advise quality, clinical, R&D, manufacturing, and supply chain teams on regulatory matters throughout the device lifecycle.
  • Lead responses to observations, questions, and non-conformities raised by health authorities and Notified Bodies.
  • Ensure compliance with post-market requirements , when applicable (PMS, PMCF, vigilance).
  • Propose and lead improvements in regulatory processes , optimizing timelines, documentation quality, and compliance.

Your profile

  • 6+ years of experience in Regulatory Affairs for medical devices.
  • Proven experience with European regulations (EU MDR) .

title: \"Analista de Infraestrutura Jr #992467\"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Atuação de nível 1

  • Conhecimento em redes de computadores.
  • Conhecimento em segurança de redes (VPN, IDS/IPS, firewalls).
  • Conhecimento em pacote office e ferramentas google.
  • Desejável conhecimento em elaboração de relatórios técnicos.
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade para trabalhar em equipe.
  • Raciocínio lógico e capacidade de análise crítica.
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Proatividade para identificar melhorias e implementar soluções
  • Conhecimento em produtos Cisco é um diferencial

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Node Senior
description:
Olá, somos a SuperFrete :)


Estamos construindo a maior e mais amada rede de logística digital, quer fazer parte disso?

Somos uma startup que atua no segmento do varejo e logística, apoiando os pequenos e médios empreendedores a se tornarem mais competitivos no mercado e a alavancarem suas vendas.

Por isso, buscamos um Super Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Node Senior , dinâmico e experiente, que se identifique com o nosso propósito, que tenha muita energia para somar no time de Tecnologia e que queira crescer (muito!) com a gente.


Responsabilidades:

  • Irá ajudar a criar e implementar soluções para manter o sistema sempre prático e escalável;
  • Fazer code reviews com atenção e cuidado;
  • Desenvolver, manter e otimizar aplicações backend usando Node.js, TypeScript e JavaScript;
  • Colaborar com a equipe de desenvolvimento para projetar e implementar soluções escaláveis e de alto desempenho;
  • Integrar sistemas com serviços de nuvem (ex: Firebase, AWS) para garantir escalabilidade e confiabilidade;
  • Desenvolver e manter bancos de dados MongoDB, garantindo eficiência e segurança;
  • Apoiar iniciativas de DevOps, automatizando processos e implantando pipelines de CI/CD;
  • Colaborar com outros membros da equipe para garantir a consistência e a qualidade do código;
  • Responder prontamente às necessidades da equipe e do projeto, resolvendo problemas com princípios de programação sólidos.


Requisitos:

  • Sólida experiência em desenvolvimento backend com Node.js;
  • Conhecimento de TypeScript e JavaScript.
  • Experiência em integração com serviços de nuvem (Firebase, AWS, GCO, Redis, etc.).
  • Familiaridade com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais, como Postgres e Mongodb;
  • Saiba escrever testes;
  • Experiência em práticas de DevOps;
  • Experiência com backend para Mobile e CRM;
  • Compreensão profunda de arquitetura de software orientada a serviços e boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Alguma experiência com desenho, construção e otimização de arquitetura serverless;
  • Experiência com Clean Code, Clean Architecture, TDD e DDD;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com problemas novos e difíceis e de contribuir para bibliotecas conforme necessário.


Será legal se você tiver:

  • Experiência como Tech Lead;
  • Experiência com CI/CD com pipelines;
  • Experiência com CRMs, como HubSpot, Huggy, Beeviral, etc.;
  • Conhecimento de métodos ágeis (Scrum/Kanban);
  • Prática com ferramentas de versionamento como o GIT.


Como é a Cultura Super?

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Java Sênior
description:
Quem somos nós?


Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:


  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?


Buscamos uma pessoa Desenvolvedora Java para atuar no desenvolvimento e evolução de soluções baseadas em arquitetura de microsserviços, trabalhando de forma próxima aos times internos e clientes.


Essa pessoa atuará no entendimento de requisitos, implementação de soluções técnicas, integrações e melhorias contínuas, sempre com foco em qualidade, escalabilidade e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?


  • Analisar e compreender as necessidades e requisitos dos clientes, trabalhando em estreita colaboração com as equipes internas e os stakeholders para implementar soluções técnicas adequadas e inovadoras.
  • Desenvolver e documentar código de alta qualidade, seguindo padrões e melhores práticas de programação, utilizando frameworks e bibliotecas apropriadas para atender aos requisitos do projeto.
  • Participar do processo completo de desenvolvimento, desde o planejamento e análise até a programação, testes e implantação, garantindo a entrega de soluções funcionais e escaláveis.
  • Colaborar com outros desenvolvedores, arquitetos e gerentes de projeto, compartilhando conhecimento e ajudando a solucionar problemas e encontrar soluções inovadoras.
  • Comunicar-se efetivamente com os membros da equipe e os stakeholders do projeto, fornecendo atualizações de progresso, discutindo desafios e soluções, e sendo capaz de responder a perguntas e resolver problemas conforme necessário.
  • Participar de revisões de código e reuniões de equipe, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua dos processos e práticas de desenvolvimento da equipe.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre as tendências do setor e desenvolvimentos tecnológicos, aplicando esse conhecimento no aprimoramento das soluções e na promoção da inovação contínua.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:


  • Sólida experiência com Java, Spring Boot, Spring Batch e arquitetura orientada a microsserviços
  • Experiência com AWS ou Azure, Docker, Kubernetes e pipelines de CI/CD
  • Conhecimento em bancos relacionais (Oracle, PostgreSQL) e não relacionais (MongoDB, Redis)
  • Domínio na criação e consumo de APIs RESTful para integração com sistemas legados e CRMs
  • Experiência com WhatsApp Business API (WABA) e provedores como Blip, Twilio ou MessageBird.


Você irá se destacar se:


  • Conhecimento em Python, especialmente para automações, integrações, jobs ou apoio a pipelines e serviços.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?


  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.


Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades. Acreditamos que a pluralidade enriquece nosso time e promove um ambiente de trabalho mais inovador e colaborativo.


Ficou com curiosidade de saber mais? #SóBora se inscrever?

title: Business Leaders (Paid Consultancy Opportunity)
description:
Company - RONIN International is an independent B2B market research company specialising in business, healthcare and tech studies. We are part of the Rippleffect Group (formerly Fat Media Group) and are Company Partners of The Market Research Society (MRS), Corporate Members of ESOMAR, Members of the Insights Association and Council Members of The Interviewer Quality Control Scheme (IQCS).



About - We are looking to speak with leaders and senior professionals —such as CEO, CFO, Director, VP, Department Head and Senior Manager .



Qualifications:

  • The purpose of this study is to gain an understanding of the global awareness of city’s attractiveness in trade, investment and partnership. I believe your opinions and expertise would be valuable for our study and I wonder if you’re interested in taking part.
  • Job titles: C-suite Executive, Partner, Director, Vice President, Head of Department and Senior Manager.
  • The paid consultancy session will be conducted as an informal 30-minute interview conducted via MS Teams and the interview can be held in either English or Portuguese.
  • Please note that, before the final interview, there'll be a 10-minute quick online screener to share more details on the research and to check that this is relevant to you.


Compensation package - BRL 790 for a 30-minute online interview.

title: System Engineer
description:
Project Description:

Our Client is one of the largest TV providers in North America. We are looking for VMWare Administrator to maintain security, performance monitoring, Installing, configuring, securing, managing, and monitoring VMware vSphere ESXi clusters in multiple data centers.


Responsibilities:

  • Installation, configuration, maintenance, tuning and troubleshooting of VMware environment running on vSphere 6.5, 6.7, 7, 8.
  • Installation of ESXi Host and vCenter Server
  • Upgrading ESXi
  • Responsible for ESXI Host Server Health Check and Performance Monitoring
  • Experience working with VCF, vCenter, vSphere, vROPs
  • Upgrade VM Tools and VM Hardware versions
  • Monitor and remediate security compliance results from tool like Nessus/Tenable
  • Perform VMware crash/error analysis, Root Cause Analysis, Coordinate Post Problem Analysis and Trend Analysis
  • Basic Linux administration
  • On-call support


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • - Operating System Proficiency, including Linux (primarily RHEL and Rocky)
  • - Server Hardware Management
  • - Virtualization, especially VMware
  • - Network Management, including DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP
  • - Security, including best practices, patch management, vulnerability assessments
  • - Monitoring and Troubleshooting


Languages:

  • English: C1 Advanced

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Company: Fraud Deflect


Role: Senior Software Engineer


Language: Native/fluent English. Resumes in English.


About the role

Own and evolve critical payments/back-office services end-to-end: design, build, ship, and operate API-first Python systems that automate disputes/chargebacks and related workflows. You’ll partner directly with clients and internal teams to translate business rules into reliable integrations, services, and data models— leveraging Linux, with a pragmatic DevOps mindset.


Responsibilities

  • Lead project execution: technical design, implementation plans, code reviews, and delivery coordination.
  • Build and operate REST APIs in Python (versioning, idempotency, auth, webhooks, integrations).
  • Own API integrations with external partners/processors: onboarding, validation, retries, error handling, and SLAs.
  • Implement complex payments/chargeback business logic from requirements and client workflows; ensure correctness and auditability.
  • Model API/domain data with strong data-structure fundamentals (schemas, invariants, normalization/denormalization tradeoffs).
  • Develop and maintain client-facing device intelligence instrumentation in JavaScript where needed (collection, privacy controls, performance).
  • Meet and maintain contact directly with clients.
  • Operate services on Linux: deployments, debugging, performance tuning, incident response, and reliability improvements.
  • Contribute to DevOps practices: CI/CD pipelines, safe rollouts, observability (logs/metrics/traces), and operational automation.


Required

  • Expert Python backend engineer (3.12+ preferred): strong typing, testing, concurrency fundamentals, and performance debugging.
  • Proven REST API development experience (design + production operations), including integrations and webhooks.
  • Strong data structures and API data modeling skills (clear contracts, backward compatibility, validations).
  • Experience implementing business logic for payments/fintech workflows, especially disputes/chargebacks and reconciliations.
  • Comfortable on Linux servers with a DevOps mindset (deploy/run/debug production services; automate operational work).
  • Client-facing technical communication: can interface with external stakeholders to clarify requirements, diagnose issues, and drive resolutions.
  • Ownership mentality and interest in leadership: drive the full lifecycle from discovery → design → build → operate.


Nice to have

  • JavaScript experience beyond basics (instrumentation, performance, privacy-aware collection) for client integrations.
  • Containerization/orchestration (Docker/Kubernetes), IaC (Terraform), and cloud-native operations on Amazon Web Services.
  • Event-driven/workflow systems (SQS/Kafka/Kinesis; Airflow/Prefect/Dagster).
  • Security/compliance exposure (PCI, SOC 2) and observability tooling at scale.


How to apply

Send an English resume and links to relevant work (repos, API docs, architectural notes, or write-ups) showing:

  • Python backend API development + real-world API integrations
  • Payments/disputes/chargebacks or similarly complex workflow automation
  • Linux/DevOps experience running production services
  • Any JavaScript instrumentation work and client-facing delivery experience

Own and evolve critical payments/back-office services end-to-end: design, build, ship, and operate API-first Python systems that automate disputes/chargebacks and related workflows. You’ll partner directly with clients and internal teams to translate business rules into reliable integrations, services, and data models— leveraging Linux, with a pragmatic DevOps mindset.


Responsibilities

  • Lead project execution: technical design, implementation plans, code reviews, and delivery coordination.
  • Build and operate REST APIs in Python (versioning, idempotency, auth, webhooks, integrations).
  • Own API integrations with external partners/processors: onboarding, validation, retries, error handling, and SLAs.
  • Implement complex payments/chargeback business logic from requirements and client workflows; ensure correctness and auditability.
  • Model API/domain data with strong data-structure fundamentals (schemas, invariants, normalization/denormalization tradeoffs).
  • Develop and maintain client-facing device intelligence instrumentation in JavaScript where needed (collection, privacy controls, performance).
  • Meet and maintain contact directly with clients.
  • Operate services on Linux: deployments, debugging, performance tuning, incident response, and reliability improvements.
  • Contribute to DevOps practices: CI/CD pipelines, safe rollouts, observability (logs/metrics/traces), and operational automation.


Required

  • Expert Python backend engineer (3.12+ preferred): strong typing, testing, concurrency fundamentals, and performance debugging.
  • Proven REST API development experience (design + production operations), including integrations and webhooks.
  • Strong data structures and API data modeling skills (clear contracts, backward compatibility, validations).
  • Experience implementing business logic for payments/fintech workflows, especially disputes/chargebacks and reconciliations.
  • Comfortable on Linux servers with a DevOps mindset (deploy/run/debug production services; automate operational work).
  • Client-facing technical communication: can interface with external stakeholders to clarify requirements, diagnose issues, and drive resolutions.
  • Ownership mentality and interest in leadership: drive the full lifecycle from discovery → design → build → operate.


Nice to have

  • JavaScript experience beyond basics (instrumentation, performance, privacy-aware collection) for client integrations.
