How to apply

Send an English resume and links to relevant work (repos, API docs, architectural notes, or write-ups) showing:

  • Python backend API development + real-world API integrations
  • Payments/disputes/chargebacks or similarly complex workflow automation
  • Linux/DevOps experience running production services
  • Any JavaScript instrumentation work and client-facing delivery experience

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
We're Hiring: Senior Data Engineer | Remote from Brazil | Fluent English required |


Location : Remote – Brazil only

Contact: PJ - Long Term


Are you passionate about building scalable data platforms and cutting-edge MLOps solutions? Do you want to work with a top-tier US company revolutionizing e-commerce and circular fashion?

We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer with strong MLOps expertise to join our growing data engineering team. This is a full-time , 100% remote opportunity exclusive to candidates located in Brazil . You'll be working with a fast-paced US-based company, leading innovations in sustainable commerce and data-driven operations.


What You’ll Do


  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable data infrastructure across real-time and batch workloads.
  • Build and support ML pipelines for model training, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with data scientists, engineers, and product teams to deliver high-performance data and ML solutions.
  • Develop APIs and services for data ingestion, transformation, and querying.
  • Ensure the reliability of ML systems through strong observability and operational tools.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and mentor team members.


Tech Stack & Requirements


  • 5+ years as a Data Engineer or MLOps Engineer.
  • Strong experience with Python , Java , or Scala .
  • Hands-on with GCP (preferred), AWS or Azure .
  • Experience with BigQuery , ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch), and container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with Apache Kafka , Spark , or similar tools is a big plus.
  • Experience with ETL , CI/CD , git , and monitoring pipelines .
  • Strong communication skills and fluency in English (written & spoken) is mandatory .
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related fields.


What We Offer


  • Top-tier hourly rate paid in USD
  • Long-term contract opportunity
  • Fully remote work – collaborate with international teams from the comfort of your home
  • A high-impact role within a data-driven, mission-oriented company

title: Senior Backend Developer (Python, SDK)
description:
About Us


We’re a fully-remote company distributed across the Americas with no physical headquarters. We help companies build great products that matter - that's what defines us as a group.


We’re a developer-first software development nearshore company. We prioritize building lasting partnerships with our clients. We go beyond just delivering code, we proactively bring forward solutions for challenging problems. Whether in our team augmentation model or our project model, we are dedicated to our client's success.


We’re like no other outsourcing company. We create a great environment for our developers and ensure they want to stick around, rather than switch to our clients. We treat our developers with respect and provide a culture of learning and growth.


Rockstar, ninja, guru? No, thanks.

Friendly, hardworking, thoughtful? Yes, please.


If you are a manager of one, friendly, hardworking, thoughtful, and you care deeply about doing great work, then you'll do just fine here.


Role Description


This is a full-time remote role for a Senior Backend Developer in Brazil. You will join one of our North American client's engineering team to maintain, design, implement, test, and deploy new features in their Python SDK as well as fix bugs, improve, and update its existing functionalities. As an experienced developer, you will be responsible for writing great documentation, doing demos, and mentoring others. You will participate in the client's team ceremonies and other sessions.


Must Have Qualifications


  • Strong English communication, writing and verbal.
  • Experience working independently and remotely.
  • Strong experience with Python.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions.
  • Experience with Public API and Python SDK on the backend implementation side.
  • Familiarity with FastAPI is a plus since one of the tasks ahead is to tighten up the client endpoints so that the developer generates well-designed and comprehensive OpenAPI specifications.
  • SDK coding for other developers


What We Offer


  • This will be a PJ hire with competitive pay in USD.
  • 100% remote work.
  • Supportive environment with 1-1 mentoring and group knowledge sharing sessions.
  • International experience working with leading startups in North America.

title: Data Platform Architect (Remote)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Data Platform Architect with 8+ years of experience to join our U.S. client. The role focuses on designing and building secure, scalable API and service integrations that connect SaaS products, data warehouses, and embedded analytics ecosystems.

The Data Platform Architect is responsible for defining, implementing, and evolving the end-to-end data architecture that powers our platform analytics, reporting, and data automation ecosystem. This role will design a scalable, automated multi-tenant data warehouse and pipeline architecture that integrates hundreds of tenant schemas from our SaaS platform into a centralized, governed, and cost-optimized analytics environment (AWS-based: Redshift, S3, Glue, Lake Formation, QuickSight).The ideal candidate combines deep data engineering expertise with systems-level architecture—balancing automation, performance, and cost while ensuring accuracy, compliance, and scalability for every customer.Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System that integrates booking, guest communications, and financial reporting, all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities


Architecture & Design

  • Architect a multi-tenant data platform capable of ingesting 500+ tenant schemas with automated onboarding/offboarding workflows
  • Design an end-to-end architecture that includes data lakes, warehouses, transformation pipelines, and semantic layers
  • Define data zone strategy (Raw Staging Serving), partitioning, and schema evolution patterns
  • Establish standards for data contracts, metadata cataloging, and lineage tracking across all tenants
  • Drive selection and configuration of core technologies (e.g., Redshift, Glue, S3, Lake Formation, dbt, Lambda, Airflow)
  • Collaborate with engineering and DevOps to ensure infrastructure as code (IaC) is applied to all data assets


Pipeline & Automation

  • Design metadata-driven ingestion and transformation pipelines supporting incremental updates, schema drift, and tenant isolation
  • Ensure pipelines are idempotent, self-healing, and fully integrated into CI/CD processes
  • Partner with the Data Pipeline Engineers to deliver automated data onboarding, testing, and quality validation


Performance & Cost Optimization

  • Define workload management, clustering, and distribution strategies in Redshift or equivalent MPP systems
  • Implement data lifecycle management policies to optimize storage and compute costs
  • Continuously evaluate query performance, caching, and concurrency scaling options


Governance & Security

  • Implement data governance frameworks to ensure privacy, PII compliance, and secure tenant isolation
  • Partner with InfoSec to align encryption (KMS multi-region keys), object lock, and access control policies with SOC/PCI/GDPR standards
  • Establish monitoring, alerting, and anomaly detection systems for data quality and operational stability


Collaboration & Leadership

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Analytics teams to ensure architecture aligns with business and product goals
  • Mentor engineers on modern data platform practices (dbt, ELT, IaC, observability)
  • Act as a technical authority and evangelist for data platform best practices within the organization


Required Experience

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or related field; or equivalent professional experience
  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 8+ years in data engineering or data architecture, including at least 3 years architecting cloud-native data platforms
  • Proven success in building and maintaining large-scale data pipelines using AWS Glue, Lambda, Step Functions, or Airflow
  • Expertise in Redshift, Snowflake, or equivalent MPP databases, including workload management and query optimization
  • Proficiency with S3-based data lakes, Glue Data Catalog, and Lake Formation
  • Deep understanding of data modeling (Kimball/ELT) and multi-tenant system design
  • Experience defining and enforcing data governance frameworks (PII, access control, lineage)
  • Proficiency with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/CloudFormation) and CI/CD for data assets
  • Strong SQL and Python skills; dbt experience preferred
  • Familiarity with embedded BI/analytics tools (QuickSight, GoodData) and semantic layer concepts


Desired Experience

  • Experience with schema-per-tenant architectures and automated tenant provisioning
  • Familiarity with Auth0 / SSO integration for analytics tools (e.g., QuickSight embedding)
  • Experience implementing observability platforms (e.g., Datadog, CloudWatch, Monte Carlo, Soda Core)
  • Exposure to data mesh or domain-oriented design principles
  • Prior experience in hospitality / property-management SaaS product ecosystems


Additional Information

  • When you know your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Consultor Técnico em Vendas
description:
CONSULTOR TÉCNICO EM VENDAS


Segmento: Movimentação e Içamento de Cargas


Profissional com forte perfil Técnico Comercial, responsável por realizar o atendimento consultivo a clientes no segmento de movimentação e içamento de cargas. Atua na identificação de necessidades, especificação de produtos (lingas de corrente, cintas, manilhas, dispositivos mecânicos, entre outros), elaboração de propostas comerciais e acompanhamento de projetos junto aos clientes.


Possuir domínio técnico sobre os produtos comercializados, normas de segurança e aplicação prática em campo. Atuar com foco em resultados, relacionamento com clientes e soluções sob medida para demandas industriais.


Principais Competências:


• Sólido conhecimento técnico em equipamentos de içamento e movimentação de cargas

• Experiência em vendas consultivas e relacionamento B2B

• Habilidade em leitura e interpretação de desenhos técnicos e especificações normativas

• Facilidade em negociações comerciais e acompanhamento de pós-venda

• Boa comunicação, postura consultiva e foco em soluções

title: Data Scientist | Senior (Remote)
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Planejar, desenvolver, treinar, avaliar e monitorar modelos de Machine Learning, utilizando abordagens clássicas, NLP/NLI e LLMs;
  • Conduzir experimentações, provas de conceito (PoCs) e iniciativas de Discovery que apoiem a tomada de decisão e a automação de processos;
  • Explorar e analisar dados de negócio, realizando análises diagnósticas, preditivas e prescritivas;
  • Avaliar, estimar e acompanhar custos de implementação e operação em escala das soluções propostas;
  • Criar relatórios, dashboards e apresentações para comunicar resultados, insights e impactos dos projetos;
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com áreas de negócio e tecnologia, alinhando expectativas e defendendo boas práticas técnicas;
  • Propor inovações, apoiar decisões técnicas e contribuir para a evolução contínua das soluções de dados e IA.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Python avançado, com experiência em bibliotecas como Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, Pydantic, PyTorch e TensorFlow;
  • SQL intermediário a avançado, com atuação em bancos de dados relacionais;
  • Experiência com Databricks;
  • Conhecimento sólido em Machine Learning, incluindo técnicas de regressão, classificação, clustering e NLP;
  • Experiência com Large Language Models (LLMs), incluindo BERT, ASR, RAG, fine-tuning e modelos generativos.



Desejáveis:

  • Experiência com frameworks e APIs de ML e GenAI, como HuggingFace, LangChain, Azure OpenAI, DSPy, LangGraph, Vertex AI.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Software Mobile - Sênior (Flutter)
description:
O que você precisa para essa posição:


Formação Acadêmica

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou experiência prática equivalente.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar na construção de uma arquitetura mobile escalável e de fácil entendimento;
  • Atuar na identificação e correção de bugs e comportamentos não desejáveis;
  • Acompanhar de forma ativa a saúde das aplicações mobile utilizando-se de métricas e relatórios;
  • Colaborar de forma ativa junto às squads no planejamento, desenvolvimento e entrega de novas funcionalidades;
  • Escrever cenários de testes automatizados buscando uma cobertura de testes ampla e confiável;
  • Trabalhar de forma contínua na identificação de melhorias e otimizações de performance;
  • Zelar pela qualidade das aplicações mobile junto às lojas;
  • Zelar pela segurança das aplicações mobile.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Sólidos conhecimentos em desenvolvimento de aplicativos utilizando Flutter;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de aplicativos nativos (Android com Kotlin/Java e/ou iOS com Swift/Obj-C) ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em desenvolvimento de aplicativos utilizando gestão de estados no padrão Bloc ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em desenvolvimento de aplicativos com Arquitetura Limpa ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em testes unitários, integração, instrumentados e E2E ;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de aplicativos modulares/multi-lib ;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de design systems ;
  • Experiência com diferentes Arquiteturas e Padrões de Projetos;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos com análise e monitoramento de erros de aplicativos em produção ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos com processo de releases nas lojas de aplicativos Google Play/Apple Store;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos com desenvolvimento e automação de esteiras de delivery .


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com frameworks e padrões de segurança, como OWASP, NIST, ISO/IEC 27001 e em programa de Security Champions.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Backend Sênior - Node.js
description:
Descrição da vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Sênior – Node.js (PIX) para atuar em projetos de alta complexidade e criticidade, dentro de um ambiente financeiro robusto, dinâmico e orientado à excelência técnica.


Você fará parte de um time altamente qualificado, responsável por desenvolver, evoluir e sustentar sistemas críticos de meios de pagamento , com forte foco em performance, segurança, escalabilidade e qualidade das entregas . Esse profissional atuará como referência técnica , contribuindo ativamente para decisões arquiteturais, definição de boas práticas e mentoria do time.


Nosso ambiente de trabalho é colaborativo, ágil e orientado a resultados, com interação constante entre Backend, Frontend, QA, UI/UX, Analistas de Sistemas e PO de negócio. Valorizamos autonomia, responsabilidade técnica e melhoria contínua.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Principais atividades:


  • Atuar no desenvolvimento e implantação de sistemas backend utilizando Node.js , seguindo boas práticas e padrões arquiteturais.
  • Desenvolver APIs RESTful robustas, seguras e escaláveis, com foco em PIX e sistemas financeiros .
  • Trabalhar com arquitetura de microserviços , containers (Docker ) e esteiras automatizadas de CI/CD .
  • Realizar análises técnicas de demandas negociais e evolutivas, em conjunto com analistas de sistemas e times de negócio.
  • Garantir a qualidade técnica , performance e segurança dos sistemas em produção e homologação.
  • Criar e manter documentação técnica e arquitetural dos sistemas.
  • Atuar na mentoria técnica da equipe , apoiando boas práticas de desenvolvimento, testes e arquitetura.
  • Contribuir para a evolução contínua da arquitetura e dos padrões técnicos adotados no CCS (MDS).

Requisitos e qualificações

Formação:


  • Formação superior completa em áreas de tecnologia


Competências esperadas:


  • Node.js com Express (ES6 ou superior).
  • Arquitetura de software , princípios RESTful e padrões de projeto.
  • MongoDB (incluindo consultas complexas com aggregate) e bancos relacionais (SQL).
  • Mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ, IBM MQ ou similares).
  • Testes unitários e de integração , qualidade de código e ferramentas como Sonar.
  • Versionamento com Git e GitFlow .

title: Bilingual Civil Engineer (Load analysis: Structural conditions of rooftops/framing systems)
description:
The Company

Datamtx ( / formerly Datamatics) established in 1993 and globally HQ'd in Atlanta has a stellar history supporting both Tier 1 and 2 Manufacturing ERP rollouts ranging from implementations, data cleanse, migrations, customization, hypercare and Day 1 support. We are also nationally aligned with leading accounting firms & VARs.

Our ERP / CRM coverage includes: SAP, Oracle EBS/Fusion, Oracle Cloud ERP, Peoplesoft, JDE, Infor (M3, LX, XA, LN, System 21), IFS, Epicor, SysPro, D365 & Salesforce.

One of our longest standing service verticals has been assisting transition clients from legacy systems to cloud based platforms including introduction of Cloud / GenAI and MS-Fabric, RAG models.


We are seeking a multiple Civil Engineers with emphasis on Load analysis: Structural conditions of rooftops/framing systems.

English language proficiency is mandatory.


These are remote roles.


This is a Civil Engineering client who are a market leader in the renewable energy industry. Ideally, they would like to start someone by early February for 11 months with an option to extend annually.

ROLES:

1) Civil Engineers (3+ years of experience)

2) Associate Civil Engineer: ACE (0-3 years of experience)


Executive Summary

Our client is dedicated to maintaining high-volume production speeds without compromising the rigorous structural safety and code compliance standards required for a 25-year system life. We require a scalable solution where a vendor-managed team can execute technical reviews, resolve engineering escalations, and maintain seamless communication across our design-to-installation pipeline.


Primary Duties

  • Reviewing structural conditions of rooftops and framing systems
  • Designing or verifying the configuration of racking and attachment systems
  • Performing load analysis to ensure compliance with applicable safety standards and expected performance over a 25-year system life
  • Working in a high-volume production environment, completing multiple project assessments per day, with some engineers averaging multiple evaluations per hour
  • The ability to maintain accuracy and consistency at scale is critical.
  • Regular shifting of work schedule may be required to support seasonal business needs
  • Turnaround Times: Core tasks are measured in business hours with expectations ranging from 4 to 24 hours depending on the task type.
  • Quality & Accountability: Staff must maintain a 95% quality score ; consistent failure to meet these standards requires a Performance Improvement Plan within 10 business days.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in an engineering discipline, with preference for civil or structural engineering
  • Professional accreditation or licensure in their home country (preferred but not mandatory)
  • Proficiency in technical analysis and structural design tools is a plus but not required
  • Strong English communication skills for coordination with US-based engineering leads


Experience level

  • Associate Civil Engineer-ACE: 0–3 years of relevant experience, ideal for early-career engineers seeking growth in a specialized field
  • Civil Engineer: 3+ years of relevant experience, ideal for early-career engineers seeking growth in a specialized field

title: Analista de Desenvolvimento Java Senior
description:
A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO:

● Desenvolver, testar e manter aplicações Java/Web, seguindo boas práticas e

padrões de arquitetura.

● Projetar e implementar camadas de persistência utilizando Hibernate e JPA.

● Criar e otimizar consultas e procedimentos em banco de dados Oracle.

● Escrever e manter testes unitários, de integração e performance.

● Participar ativamente das cerimônias e processos ágeis (planning, dailies,

reviews, retrospectivas).

● Participar de revisões de código e contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos

processos.

● Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares (QA, DevOps, Product) para

entregar soluções alinhadas às necessidades do negócio.

● Identificar e resolver gargalos de performance e problemas complexos em

produção.

● Orientar desenvolvedores juniores e plenos.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER:

● Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou

áreas correlatas.

● Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software com Java.

● Experiência sólida com frameworks de persistência: Hibernate e JPA.

● Conhecimento avançado em banco de dados Oracle (modelagem, SQL, PL/SQL, performance tuning).

● Vivência em desenvolvimento de testes automatizados (JUnit, Mockito ou similares).

● Experiência com APIs RESTful, microsserviços e padrões de integração.

● Conhecimento em ferramentas de controle de versão (Git) e CI/CD.

● Capacidade analítica para resolver problemas complexos e propor soluções técnicas eficientes.


DIFERENCIAL:

● Experiência prática em desenvolvimento utilizando metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban), com habilidade para contribuir ativamente na melhoria contínua do processo.

● Conhecimento em Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Docker e Kubernetes.

● Experiência com mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ).

● Familiaridade com monitoramento (ELK, Prometheus, Grafana).

● Certificações Oracle, Java ou em metodologias ágeis (Scrum Master, Product

Owner).

● Vivência em ambientes de alta disponibilidade e escalabilidade.

● Experiência com práticas de DevOps e entrega contínua.

Competências Comportamentais

● Proatividade e autonomia para liderar técnicamente iniciativas.

● Boa comunicação para interagir com times técnicos e não técnicos.

● Mentalidade colaborativa e aberta para compartilhar conhecimento.

● Adaptabilidade para trabalhar em ambientes dinâmicos e interativos.

● Atualização constante sobre novas tecnologias e tendências do mercado.



O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

title: Backend Developer Mid-level (JAVA)
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

#


O que esperar do seu dia a dia:

Buscamos um profissional Backend Java com fluência em inglês para contribuir ativamente com o time. Contrato inicial de 3 meses para atuação no projeto, com possibilidade de prorrogação. A atuação envolve desenvolvimento e evolução de soluções backend utilizando JAVA. Oportunidade global de crescimento, com interação constante e troca de experiências com times diversos e internacionais!


O que você precisa ter:

  • Expertise em Java (JDK 8+), Spring Boot, Hibernate e multithreading.
  • SQL e Gerenciamento de Bancos de Dados – Sólido conhecimento em SQL, bancos de dados relacionais (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle) e técnicas de otimização.
  • Microserviços e Desenvolvimento de APIs – Experiência no desenho de APIs RESTful e atuação com arquitetura de microserviços.
  • Otimização de Performance – Proficiência em indexação de banco de dados, otimização de queries, uso de cache (Redis, Memcached) e ajuste da JVM.
  • Cloud e DevOps – Familiaridade com plataformas de cloud (Azure), pipelines de CI/CD e conteinerização (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Segurança e Boas Práticas – Conhecimento em autenticação (OAuth, JWT), criptografia e práticas de codificação segura.
  • Arquitetura de Sistemas e Escalabilidade – Conhecimento em sistemas distribuídos, filas de mensagens e arquiteturas de alta disponibilidade.
  • Idioma: Inglês fluente - necessário para comunicação.


Modelo de Atuação:

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

Horário: BRASILEIRO (BRT)- das 6h às 15h. Esse horário foi escolhido para permitir mais horas de interação com a equipe!

title: Recruiter Assistant
description:
Bilingual Recruiter Assistant (Fluent English – C1) | 100% Remote


At Blue Dot BPO , we connect top LATAM talent with high-performance executive teams at U.S.-based companies. We are looking for a Recruiter Assistant with excellent English communication skills, strong organization, and a proactive mindset to support high-volume recruiting operations.


This is a fully remote role focused on the U.S. market, offering daily exposure to global teams and a clear growth path for those who want to build a career in recruitment.


What We Offer

  • Fixed pay of R$4,000
  • 100% remote , working directly with U.S.-based recruiting teams
  • Monday to Friday, 1 PM to 10 PM (BRT)
  • Fast-track growth opportunities (executive recruiting, leadership, or management)
  • International networking and a multicultural environment
  • Paid training and structured onboarding


Your Responsibilities

  • Support the client’s U.S.-based recruiting team in sourcing and pre-qualifying candidates
  • Conduct initial screenings via phone calls, emails, and messages
  • Keep databases updated (job boards and ATS)
  • Write and update job descriptions and candidate profiles
  • Source talent through job boards and resume databases
  • Manage calendars and support communication flow between candidates and recruiters
  • Assist with administrative tasks related to recruitment operations and team organization


What We’re Looking For

  • Advanced English (C1), strong written and spoken communication required
  • Highly organized, focused, and able to manage multiple priorities
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and delivery-focused
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment


Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in recruitment or talent acquisition
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter, Dynamics, or other ATS platforms
  • Experience in high-volume recruiting environments with tight deadlines


Technical Requirements

  • Two monitors | i5 / i7 processor (or equivalent) | 12GB+ RAM
  • High-speed internet
  • Headset with microphone and a quiet workspace

title: Front-End & UI/UX Designer (Webflow + WordPress)
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yep—you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a versatile, design-driven Webflow + WordPress expert who can take a website from concept to completion.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.

Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.



What You’ll Do


  • Design and develop responsive, visually engaging websites in Webflow and WordPress .
  • Create wireframes, prototypes, and full website designs that align with user needs and client goals.
  • Translate approved designs into fully-built, functional websites using Webflow or WordPress.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to clarify requirements and ensure flawless execution.
  • Ensure all designs follow UX/UI best practices , accessibility standards, and performance guidelines.
  • Customize, refine, and optimize websites based on client feedback.
  • Stay up-to-date with digital design trends, tools, and new Webflow/WordPress capabilities.
  • Troubleshoot design-related issues and ensure smooth handoff and deployment.


What You Bring


  • 3+ years of professional experience designing AND developing websites using Webflow and WordPress .
  • A strong portfolio showcasing web design, UX/UI work, prototypes, and completed builds .
  • Proficiency in wireframing tools and design platforms (Figma, XD, Sketch, etc.).
  • Solid understanding of HTML, CSS , and responsive design principles.
  • Experience with site performance optimization and SEO-friendly design practices.
  • Ability to work effectively within a fully remote team.
  • Strong communication skills—you can articulate design decisions clearly.
  • Close attention to detail and a passion for creating elevated digital experiences.



Bonus Points


  • Experience with animations or micro-interactions in Webflow.
  • Familiarity with brand identity or graphic design.
  • Experience working in fast-paced agency settings.



Work Details


  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST , Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


If you’re someone who can dream up a beautiful interface, bring it to life, and polish it until it shines, we want to hear from you.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Visual Effects Artist
description:
Who we are:


Apex Systems is a leading professional services organization focused on providing solutions with real business value. We provide a customer-focused approach to building authentic partnerships with our clients.


We are seeking a VFX Artist to join the team supporting an international world-wide gaming client and the next‑generation evolution of the franchise

This role will focus on real‑time VFX for core gameplay and visuals, helping deliver next‑gen quality while meeting sprint‑based production needs.


We’re looking for someone with a strong sense of dramatic, dynamic visual effects, a critical eye for timing and motion, and the technical ability to bring these effects to life inside Unreal Engine.

You’ll work closely with a small, collaborative team, contribute to a mix of styles ranging from stylized to ESPN‑inspired sports broadcast polish, and help push the Client's visuals forward.


In This Role, You Will:


  • Execute high‑quality real‑time VFX for the client.
  • Create all necessary art for visual effects, including concepts, prototypes, textures, materials, and final in‑game FX.
  • Develop effects across a wide range of styles, from realistic to stylized, with an emphasis on high‑energy gameplay readability.
  • Contribute to next‑gen arena visuals, gameplay moments (flips, jumps, boosts, grabs), and new core‑loop effects.
  • Work within Unreal Engine 5 using Blueprints, materials, shaders, and logic-driven systems.
  • Collaborate with engineers, artists, and designers to ensure FX integrate smoothly into gameplay and pipelines.
  • Support sprint deliverables and production deadlines leading up to major milestones.


About the Project:


This role helps support Project Coronado, a next‑gen porting of the core Gaming experience, with:


  • Updated visuals for arenas and core gameplay elements.
  • A shift toward ESPN-style, sports-broadcast-inspired VFX, with less traditional arcade styling.
  • A focus on scripting-heavy FX behaviors and technical implementation.
  • No cosmetics work — purely gameplay and core experience.
  • August delivery milestones requiring additional mid‑level VFX support.


Day-to-Day Responsibilities


  • Primarily execution-focused work rather than high-concept ideation.
  • Implementing technical FX solutions using Blueprints, shaders, logic systems, and materials.
  • Creating textures and materials as needed to support FX systems.
  • Working cross-functionally with a small, agile team.
  • Contributing to a live service pipeline with frequent iteration and updates.


Requirements


  • Strong portfolio/reel demonstrating high-quality real-time VFX.
  • Proficiency with Unreal Engine (UE5 preferred).
  • Experience with Blueprints, materials, shaders, and logic-driven FX.
  • Solid technical background paired with strong artistic instincts.
  • Experience working on live service or active production projects.
  • Ability to create all components needed for VFX (textures, meshes, materials, prototypes).
  • Strong sense of timing, weight, animation principles, and motion.
  • Eager to keep learning.


Nice to have


  • Experience with Call of Duty–style FX sensibilities (timing, punch, clarity).
  • Strong animation fundamentals — especially movement, impact, and timing.
  • Experience shipping multiple titles in the game industry.
  • Desire to grow pipelines, tools, and collaborative processes.

title: Visual Effects Artist
description:
Who we are:


Apex Systems is a leading professional services organization focused on providing solutions with real business value. We provide a customer-focused approach to building authentic partnerships with our clients.


We are seeking a VFX Artist to join the team supporting an international world-wide gaming client and the next‑generation evolution of the franchise

This role will focus on real‑time VFX for core gameplay and visuals, helping deliver next‑gen quality while meeting sprint‑based production needs.


We’re looking for someone with a strong sense of dramatic, dynamic visual effects, a critical eye for timing and motion, and the technical ability to bring these effects to life inside Unreal Engine.

You’ll work closely with a small, collaborative team, contribute to a mix of styles ranging from stylized to ESPN‑inspired sports broadcast polish, and help push the Client's visuals forward.


In This Role, You Will:


  • Execute high‑quality real‑time VFX for the client.
  • Create all necessary art for visual effects, including concepts, prototypes, textures, materials, and final in‑game FX.
  • Develop effects across a wide range of styles, from realistic to stylized, with an emphasis on high‑energy gameplay readability.
  • Contribute to next‑gen arena visuals, gameplay moments (flips, jumps, boosts, grabs), and new core‑loop effects.
  • Work within Unreal Engine 5 using Blueprints, materials, shaders, and logic-driven systems.
  • Collaborate with engineers, artists, and designers to ensure FX integrate smoothly into gameplay and pipelines.
  • Support sprint deliverables and production deadlines leading up to major milestones.


About the Project:


This role helps support Project Coronado, a next‑gen porting of the core Gaming experience, with:


  • Updated visuals for arenas and core gameplay elements.
  • A shift toward ESPN-style, sports-broadcast-inspired VFX, with less traditional arcade styling.
  • A focus on scripting-heavy FX behaviors and technical implementation.
  • No cosmetics work — purely gameplay and core experience.
  • August delivery milestones requiring additional mid‑level VFX support.


Day-to-Day Responsibilities


  • Primarily execution-focused work rather than high-concept ideation.
  • Implementing technical FX solutions using Blueprints, shaders, logic systems, and materials.
  • Creating textures and materials as needed to support FX systems.
  • Working cross-functionally with a small, agile team.
  • Contributing to a live service pipeline with frequent iteration and updates.


Requirements


  • Strong portfolio/reel demonstrating high-quality real-time VFX.
  • Proficiency with Unreal Engine (UE5 preferred).
  • Experience with Blueprints, materials, shaders, and logic-driven FX.
  • Solid technical background paired with strong artistic instincts.
  • Experience working on live service or active production projects.
  • Ability to create all components needed for VFX (textures, meshes, materials, prototypes).
  • Strong sense of timing, weight, animation principles, and motion.
  • Eager to keep learning.


Nice to have


  • Experience with Call of Duty–style FX sensibilities (timing, punch, clarity).
  • Strong animation fundamentals — especially movement, impact, and timing.
  • Experience shipping multiple titles in the game industry.
  • Desire to grow pipelines, tools, and collaborative processes.

description:

● Be responsible for monitoring and troubleshooting Kofax, DSP, E2E reporting and Webstatus .net applications based on SQL server , deployed on Windows Server IIS.

● Monitor Jobs and remediate any failures

title: Product implementer / DTP freelancer
description:
Do you like mixing creativity with technical skills?

Do you have experience in DTP or a desire to learn it?

BubblyDoo is looking for a hands-on freelance full remote Product Implementer to join our team ASAP on a full time basis.


You will kick off with Mother's Day, and Father’s Day books for our in-house products, but also for various licensing partners (such as Peppa Pig from Hasbro, PAW Patrol from Paramount, Barbie from Mattel, and more!). You will support the launch of new personalized children’s books and products, working closely with our in-house team and software developer.


What you’ll do

  • Use various in-house tools like our Translation Tool and Product Builder to fully implement the translations and our books
  • Prepare and configure our CMS for each new launch
  • Have direct contact with our translators, illustrators and editors for quality review and product improvements
  • Support with organizing Photoshop files to ensure all visual assets are ready for production


What we’re looking for

  • Full time or part time availability from February 2026, with an initial onboarding and training phase, for the first few months.
  • Strong communication skills in an international environment
  • A feeling for design but also technically strong
  • Comfortable using internal tools and learning quickly
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and structured


What’s in it for you

  • Join a small, young, and passionate team that cares deeply about what we create
  • Take ownership and responsibility for the quality of our product line
  • Compensation of $1500/month (usd)


For questions or more information about the role, don’t hesitate to reach out to


Looking forward to connect and to a great collaboration!

title: Private Equity Professional — AI Research
description:
We are looking for experienced private equity and finance professionals to support frontier AI research focused on institutional-grade financial analysis, modeling, and investment decision systems.


This role is ideal for professionals with a deal-driven background who want to apply their judgment, pattern recognition, and modeling experience to the development of advanced AI tools used in real investment workflows.


Why Apply

  • Competitive Pay: Benefit from attractive hourly rates and potential performance-based incentives
  • Impactful Work: Play a key role in advancing AI capabilities within a forward-thinking, Founders Fund-backed startup
  • Flexible Environment: Enjoy the freedom of remote, asynchronous work that adapts to your schedule while contributing to groundbreaking technology


Requirements

  • 3–5+ years of professional experience
  • Availability: 18–40 hours/week (flexible)
  • Minimum commitment: 1 month, with the option to continue long-term


Expertise

  • Strong command of GAAP and financial statement analysis
  • Advanced Excel-based financial modeling (LBOs, operating models, scenario analysis)
  • Hands-on experience evaluating companies, transactions, or investments
  • Background in private equity, private credit, structured finance, or investment banking preferred


Engagement Details

  • Fully remote
  • Ongoing, research-driven work at the intersection of finance and AI


Compensation

  • $30-35 USD per hour
